name: 547. Hybrid log store serves each log while its upload is held or fails (hybrid-logstore) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7326. The hybrid log store keeps a summary row in the database and offloads each log's payload to object storage, and its bugs live in the order of those uploads (TXE-7318, TXE-7325). This folder proves the harness can reach that: the hybrid-logstore group of tests/e2e/api/runners/fixture-folders.mjs runs the provider-error gateway with logs_store.object_storage pointing at the S3-compatible store that provider-error-fixture.mjs serves on its main port (tests/e2e/api/runners/lib/s3-object-fixture.mjs). Rows hold or fail a chosen PUT through that store's control API (/__s3/control) and read the log back through GET /api/logs/{id}. Pins: a landed upload is stored under the log's key and the log is served from it with its output; while the upload is held the log is served from its row (the last user message, no output) and from the object once the upload lands; a failed upload stores nothing and the row is served. Red without the group's object storage (no PUT reaches the store, so every state wait times out); green on this change.
